narrative.overview:
Accord is a restrained editorial workspace for running a hybrid human and AI workforce and proving what it was allowed to do. Warm stone ground and paper surfaces carry the working day; a single night violet-black rail anchors navigation, and one violet accent marks interaction and verified value. Hairline borders replace shadows, actions are pills, figures are tabular.

Certainty is drawn: verified is solid violet, estimated is hatched, unmeasured is outlined. The signature move is the monospace #seq sequence gutter anchoring timelines, evidence and the event log. Geist is a user-pinned choice, with Geist Mono for identity and one Newsreader italic phrase for editorial voice.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone and paper neutrals with violet-tinted ink, never pure grey or white.
Night appears twice: the nav rail, and the Assure lane card on Overview.
Flat at rest; only overlays and the toast carry a shadow.
Solid / hatched / outlined encodes verified / estimated / unmeasured everywhere value appears.
Mono #seq gutter as the recurring structural device.

rules.name: The Three Value Marks Rule
rules.body: Verified is solid violet, estimated is hatched, unmeasured is outlined/dashed. Any new surface showing value uses these marks and never adds the three into one figure.

rules.name: The Reserved Hue Rule
rules.body: Violet is interaction and verified value; red/amber is severity and denial; green is allowed. No color is borrowed for decoration.

rules.name: The Night Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Night fills only the navigation rail, the Assure lane card, and the toast.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Newsreader italic appears only for one accent phrase inside a page title and for empty-state titles. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The Mono Means Identity Rule
rules.body: If it is an id, scope or sequence number, it is Geist Mono, tabular, muted.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card never casts a shadow; it earns its edge with a 1px hairline.

dos: Do mark value with solid, hatched and outlined fills, and keep the three figures separate.
Do set every id, scope and sequence number in Geist Mono, tabular, ink-3.
Do use hairline borders on stone/paper and reserve shadows for dialogs, drawers and the toast.
Do use pill shapes for actions and 8/12/16px radii for containers.
Do keep violet for interaction and verified value, red/amber for severity, green for allowed.
Do put the single italic serif phrase in the page title and in empty-state titles only.
Do keep text pairs at WCAG AA using ink / ink-2 / ink-3; use ink-4 for non-text only.
donts: Don't add or blend verified, estimated and unmeasured value into one number.
Don't use shadows or colored side stripes to lift cards.
Don't use night fills beyond the rail, the Assure card and the toast.
Don't reintroduce the generic blue-and-white dashboard look or a row of metric cards.
Don't use Newsreader for body, labels or numbers.
